# Workspace Prompt Files

These slash commands are available in VS Code Copilot Chat for this workspace.

## Session and planning

- `/session-start` — start session protocol from roadmap
- `/task-brief` — generate a delegation brief with acceptance criteria
- `/daily-triage` — daily priorities, risks, and action plan

## Delivery and quality

- `/scraper-bugfix` — bugfix flow with test-first validation
- `/run-local` — full local run flow with preflight checks
- `/adr-check` — check whether architectural decision record is required
- `/release-readiness` — GO/NO-GO validation before rollout
- `/weekly-health-check` — weekly stability and monitoring review

## Notes

- Prompt files are stored in `.github/prompts/`.
- Custom agents are stored in `.github/agents/`.
- Use `orchestrator` as the default entry agent when unsure.
